title: VIGIL Response Schema
description: Schema for VIGIL [Strategist] structured response back to ULTRON. Contains strategic analysis, decisions, architecture guidance, and risks.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'vigil' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the agent's work. 'success' = completed fully, 'partial' = completed with caveats, 'error' = could not complete.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what VIGIL analyzed/decided. Used by ULTRON for consolidation.

artifacts.description: Concrete outputs produced by VIGIL's analysis

storyFile.description: Path or name of the story file created by VIGIL (e.g. 'story-20260218T220000.md'), null if no story file was generated

storyTaskCount.description: Number of tasks defined in the story file (0 if no story file)

justification.description: Why this approach was chosen over alternatives

alternatives.description: Alternative approaches that were considered and rejected

architecture.description: Architecture description or guidance for the implementation phase

risks.description: Identified risks, caveats, or concerns about the approach

issues.description: Issues or blockers found during analysis

analysisDepth.description: Whether a full or quick analysis was performed

debateRequired.description: Whether VIGIL recommends an inter-agent debate before proceeding

debateTopics.description: Topics that should be debated if debateRequired is true

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.

vaultConsulted.description: Confirmation of the MANDATORY step-0 Vault consultation. True = VIGIL consulted the Vault paths in context.vaultPaths (or attempted and found them empty) BEFORE planning. False/absent = not consulted (only acceptable for a new project with an empty Vault). Optional for backward compatibility, but VIGIL MUST set it true on every mission.
